Anticipatory Bail Application No. 561 Of 2025
Ashu Ali ..... Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand .....Respondent

Counsel for the Applicant : Mr. Narendra Bali,
 Advocate.

Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Pradeep Lohani,
 Brief Holder.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
The present Application has been filed by the applicant Ashu Ali seeking anticipatory bail under
Section 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in the First Information Report bearing
registration no.193 of 2025, registered at Police Station Ranipur, District Haridwar.

2.  According to the First Information Report dated 11.05.2025 lodged by the informant, the applicant had raped her in her house one and a half years ago when her husband was not present at the house and on 06.01.2025, the applicant came to her house and beat her.
3. Heard Mr. Narendra Bali, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Pradeep Lohani, learned Brief Holder for the respondent.
4. Mr. Narendra Bali, Advocate, contended that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present matter.

The father of the present applicant filed an Application under Section 175(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on 17.01.2025 stating therein that his younger son Ashu (present applicant) was sleeping on 05.01.2025 at around 12:00 hrs. in the night when the informant called on the applicant's mobile phone from her mobile phone and told him that she is feeling unwell.
She requested the applicant to come to take her to the doctor.
Applicant reached the informant's house at around 12:30 a.m., where he was beaten.
The First Information Report of the applicant's father was registered on 19.02.2025.

5. Mr. Pradeep Lohani, Brief Holder, has sought three weeks' time to file objection to the Ashu Ali vs State Of Uttarakhand on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186968997/
1 anticipatory bail application.

sentences.text:
7. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant Ashu Ali, he shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
8. List on 10.07.2025 for hearing on the anticipatory bail application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
